{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Ensure we only keep the highest sample_seq for each patient
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Filter for patients with SEVERE disease
severe_patients = trial_df[trial_df['severity'] == 'severe']

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
severe_patients['biomarker_baseline'].describe()"}
